criteria.description: Reference is preserved and visibly inspected; observed features and inferred additions are distinguished.
Focal point, palette, edge treatment, movement restraint, sound story, and intended audience are specified.
Format, durations, tool availability, reuse scope, and generation spending authority are recorded.
Every visible object has draw order, depth, bounds, anchor, and a motion method.
Hidden backgrounds and borders that camera motion can reveal have clean-plate or mask plans.
Groups and attachment sockets keep architecture, smoke, lights, and ground consistent.
Files, dimensions, atlas geometry, alpha availability, and hashes were checked; attach the actual report.
Cels were inspected in sequence for scale, pivot drift, neighboring fragments, and closing pose continuity.
Cutouts and cels fit the reference style; alpha edges and the unlit/emissive relationship were visually reviewed.
Sources, prompts, references, returned IDs where available, selected takes, and preparation recipes are retained.
The same time produces the same scene state; motion and cel cycles fit the picture loop.
Zero/end state and last-to-first transition were checked; camera extremes reveal no missing artwork.
A full draft was reviewed at phone size for attachment drift, flicker, frame jitter, visual hierarchy, and motion density.
The music and near/middle/distant sounds support a specific emotional idea with room for quiet.
Selected sources were auditioned for hiss, harshness, unwanted layers, and distracting repetition; audition method is stated.
Selected source files, requests, settings, actual formats, and generation outcomes are retained.
Music phrasing, ambience beds, event tails, and master duration close musically and technically.
Sample counts, clipping, level, peak method, mono compatibility, and stem alignment have actual measurement evidence.
Picture with sound was heard across three repeats; volume pumping, clicks, fatigue, and obvious restarts were considered.
The actual final video was decoded completely; picture count, dimensions, frame rate, ordered timing, and presented audio length were verified.
The encoded soundtrack and loop join were checked on the presentation timeline, accounting for codec padding.
Requested editions, cover, masters, and labels match the brief; no silent or stale mix is mislabeled as final.
A person reviewed the exact final file for the intended cozy/spooky balance and comfortable repetition.
A person checked the exact final file on a phone, including picture crop, readable detail, and speaker sound.
Intended use and asset terms have been reviewed as applicable; publishing destination and authority are explicit.
Scene, sound session, source references, tool versions, evidence, and rebuild limits are recorded.
Accepted assets, rigs, motion recipes, and sound recipes have stable IDs, hashes, and compatibility notes.
A new operator can locate the final files, next actions, known limits, and reusable pieces without this chat.
